result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on top of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, suggesting the image or an overlay element failed to finish loading.

issues.description: A loading spinner remains visible in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image even though the underlying image appears rendered, indicating a stuck or orphaned loading state.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the spinner is removed once the image load event fires, and add a timeout/fallback so the loading indicator never persists indefinitely over loaded content.
